headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after 33 years
[Big Step!] Russia and Ukraine Agree to a [Large Prisoner Swap] After Abu Dhabi Talks
caption:
🕊️ Russia and Ukraine agree to a large prisoner swap

Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a large exchange of prisoners of war after two days of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi, both sides said on Wednesday. These were the first direct talks between the two countries in nine months.

🔹 The swap was confirmed by Russia's chief negotiator Vladimir Medinsky and Ukraine's Rustem Umerov. The exact numbers are still being finalised.
🔹 US envoy Jared Kushner called it the "biggest humanitarian release of prisoners" of the war.
🔹 No deal was reached on a ceasefire, territory or security guarantees. US envoys Kushner and Steve Witkoff then met President Putin in Moscow and President Zelensky in Ireland, and say a new round of talks is planned.

💬 Do you think these talks can bring the war closer to an end? 👇

Sources: AP, Reuters, ABC News

#GlobalEye #Russia #Ukraine #PrisonerSwap #AbuDhabi #WorldNews
photo_needed: A photo from the US-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi (delegations at the table), or the Russian and Ukrainian negotiators.

headline: [Global Outage!] Microsoft Outlook and Teams Go Down for [5+ Hours]
sub: Over 138,000 problem reports at peak
caption:
💻 Microsoft Outlook and Teams down for hours

A major Microsoft 365 outage disrupted Outlook email, Teams and other Microsoft services for more than five hours on Thursday, Reuters reported. Problems began around 12:30 p.m. US Eastern time, and Microsoft said users in any region could be affected.

🔹 Problem reports for Outlook on Downdetector peaked at more than 138,000, according to Reuters.
🔹 Microsoft said a number of servers became unexpectedly unavailable because of elevated load, mainly hitting Exchange Online email.
🔹 Microsoft said it was returning servers to service and moving traffic, and warned that recovery would be gradual as users reconnect.

💬 Were you affected by the Microsoft outage? 👇

Sources: Reuters, ABC News

#GlobalEye #Microsoft #Outlook #Teams #Outage #Tech
photo_needed: Microsoft logo sign or Microsoft office building (no people needed). A clear photo of the Outlook or Teams logo on a screen also works.

headline: [Tensions Rise!] Iran Says It Hit a [US Radar] in Bahrain
sub: The claim has not been independently verified
caption:
⚠️ Iran Says It Hit a US Radar in Bahrain

Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) said on Friday that they targeted and destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain. Iran's state news agency IRNA reported the statement. AP and Al Jazeera said the claim could not be independently verified, and the US and Bahrain did not comment straight away.

🔹 The IRGC said it was a reply to an attack on a telecom tower in Sirik, a port city in southern Iran, on Thursday.
🔹 According to Reuters, it is Iran's first claimed attack on US military assets in a Gulf country since early September.
🔹 Bahrain hosts the headquarters of the US Navy's Fifth Fleet. The IRGC warned it is ready to act again.

💬 Do you think talks can stop the tension from growing? 👇

Sources: AP, Al Jazeera, Reuters

#GlobalEye #Iran #Bahrain #USA #MiddleEast #WorldNews
photo_needed: A US military radar or US Navy base in Bahrain, or an IRGC missile launch photo. A map-style image of Bahrain and Iran also works (no people needed).

headline: [New Twist!] Trump Says [Tim Cook] Should Replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO
sub: Huang agrees to testify before Congress
caption:
💻 Trump says Tim Cook should lead Nvidia

US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that Apple's Tim Cook should become the new CEO of Nvidia, after Jensen Huang stepped down. In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote that there is "only one man" to take Huang's place and called it "A Legend replaces a Legend!"

🔹 Nvidia has named its finance chief, Colette Kress, as interim CEO while its board looks for a permanent leader.
🔹 Tim Cook stepped down as Apple CEO in September and is now executive chairman of Apple's board.
🔹 Huang has agreed to testify before US lawmakers in a closed-door session by Thanksgiving, House Foreign Affairs Committee chairman Brian Mast said.

💬 Who do you think should lead Nvidia next? 👇

Sources: NBC News, Fox Business, TechCrunch

#GlobalEye #Nvidia #TimCook #JensenHuang #Trump #Tech
photo_needed: Tim Cook, face clearly visible (e.g. at an Apple event). A photo of Tim Cook with Trump also works.

headline: [Cuba Warning!] Trump Says He Wants to [Get Cuba Done] Before Leaving Office
sub: He says he would consider military force
caption:
🌎 Trump Says He Wants to "Get Cuba Done" Before Leaving Office

US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that he wants to "get Cuba done" before he leaves office in 2029. Speaking in a radio interview with host Hugh Hewitt, he said he would consider using military force against Cuba and that his team is "watching it very closely."

🔹 Politico reported this is the first time Trump has given a timeline for possible action on Cuba.
🔹 Trump said Secretary of State Marco Rubio, whose parents are from Cuba, "would love to do it."
🔹 Since January, the US has blocked most oil shipments to Cuba, which has led to blackouts and food and fuel shortages. Cuban officials have said the island is ready for any attack.

💬 What do you think will happen next between the US and Cuba? 👇

Sources: Al Jazeera, Politico, The Hill

#GlobalEye #Cuba #USA #Trump #WorldNews #Politics
photo_needed: Donald Trump, face clearly visible (a recent photo). A photo of Havana, Cuba with the Cuban flag also works.

headline: [Shock Collapse!] India All Out for [89] as New Zealand Win by 244 Runs
sub: Matt Henry takes 6 wickets, Will Young hits 125
caption:
🏏 India All Out for 89 as New Zealand Win by 244 Runs

New Zealand beat India by 244 runs in the fourth ODI at Bay Oval, Mount Maunganui, on Friday. New Zealand made 333, and India were bowled out for just 89 in reply.

🔹 Fast bowler Matt Henry took 6 wickets for 27 runs. Reuters reported he took three wickets in his first over, including Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli.
🔹 Will Young scored 125 from 108 balls, his fifth ODI hundred.
🔹 India still lead the five-match series 2-1 (the third match was washed out by rain). The last match is on Sunday at the same ground.

💬 What went wrong for India today? 👇

Sources: Al Jazeera, Reuters, ESPNcricinfo

#GlobalEye #INDvNZ #Cricket #MattHenry #WillYoung #TeamIndia
photo_needed: Matt Henry (New Zealand bowler) celebrating a wicket, face clearly visible. A New Zealand team celebration photo also works.

headline: [Big Homecoming!] Pope Leo Returns to the Peru City He Led as [Bishop]
sub: Up to 1 million expected at his Mass
caption:
🙏 Pope Leo Returns to the Peru City He Led as Bishop

Pope Leo XIV arrived in Chiclayo, Peru, on Friday for an outdoor Mass in the city where he served as bishop for eight years. Local officials said up to 1 million people could attend.

🔹 Before becoming pope, Leo (born Robert Prevost in Chicago) worked in Peru for about 20 years as a missionary priest and bishop.
🔹 In Lima on Wednesday, about 3 million people came out to see him, the biggest crowd of his papacy so far, Reuters reported.
🔹 Peru is the last stop of his 12-day South America trip, after Argentina and Uruguay. He stays in the Chiclayo area until Sunday.

💬 Have you ever seen the Pope in person? 👇

Sources: Reuters, AP

#GlobalEye #PopeLeo #PopeLeoXIV #Peru #Chiclayo #Vatican
photo_needed: Pope Leo XIV, face clearly visible (best: greeting the crowds in Peru, waving from the popemobile).

headline: [Massive Attack!] Ukraine Fires Nearly [1,200 Drones] at Russia Overnight
sub: Russia says it shot down 1,198 drones
caption:
⚠️ Ukraine Fires Nearly 1,200 Drones at Russia Overnight

Ukraine launched almost 1,200 drones at Russia overnight from Thursday to Friday, one of its biggest air attacks since the full-scale war began nearly five years ago. Russia's Defence Ministry said its air defences shot down 1,198 drones over more than 15 regions.

🔹 Russian officials reported deaths. At least four workers were killed in an industrial area in the Volgograd region, the regional governor said.
🔹 Moscow's mayor said 467 drones were heading for the capital. Russia also attacked Ukraine overnight; Ukrainian officials said at least two people were killed in Odesa.
🔹 The attack came after two days of US-led talks in Abu Dhabi. US envoys say Europe will join the next round of peace talks.

💬 Do you think the peace talks can stop the war? 👇

Sources: AP, Al Jazeera, AFP

#GlobalEye #Ukraine #Russia #Drones #UkraineWar #WorldNews
photo_needed: A Ukrainian long-range drone, or Russian air defence firing at night, or drone wreckage in Russia. A big landscape photo works best (no people needed).

headline: [Nvidia Scandal Grows!] US Commerce Chief [Lutnick] Agrees to Testify Before Senate
sub: Senate probe into AI chips reaching China
caption:
💻 Nvidia Scandal Grows: US Commerce Chief Lutnick Agrees to Testify Before Senate

US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has agreed to appear before the Senate Banking Committee, CNN and CBS News reported on Friday. The committee is looking at how advanced Nvidia AI chips may have reached China, and why the US did not act sooner.

🔹 Committee chairman Senator Tim Scott asked Lutnick to testify on December 10. A source said the details are still being worked out.
🔹 The probe centres on Megaspeed, a Singapore-based Nvidia customer that US officials suspect of helping Chinese firms get around chip export limits. China rejects the spying claims linked to the case.
🔹 Lawmakers have also asked former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned this week, to testify in early December, and warned they could use subpoenas.

💬 Should the US be stricter about selling AI chips to China? 👇

Sources: CNN, CBS News, CNBC

#GlobalEye #Nvidia #Lutnick #AIChips #China #TechNews
photo_needed: Howard Lutnick (US Commerce Secretary), face clearly visible. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Rare Shutdown!] US Grounds Flights Nationwide for [4+ Hours]
sub: Air traffic communication failure halts departures
caption:
✈️ Rare Shutdown: US Grounds Flights Nationwide for 4+ Hours

The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) stopped flights from taking off at all US airports on Friday afternoon, after a communication problem hit air traffic control centres across the country. Departures were halted for more than four hours before the FAA lifted the order late Friday.

🔹 The FAA said the ground stop was ordered "for reasons of safety" after "communication issues" at multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers. Technicians are still looking into the cause.
🔹 By Friday evening, FlightAware showed more than 1,900 flights cancelled and over 10,000 delayed in the US. Delays are expected to continue.
🔹 Officials said there was no sign of a "nefarious" act. It was the first nationwide ground stop since January 2023.

💬 Have you ever been stuck at an airport because of a big delay? 👇

Sources: CBS News, ABC News, Al Jazeera, FAA

#GlobalEye #FAA #Flights #USA #AirTravel #WorldNews
photo_needed: A busy US airport departures board showing many delayed/cancelled flights, or planes parked at a US airport gate (no person needed). A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Health Setback!] US Reportedly Loses Measles-Free Status After [26 Years]
sub: Measles kept spreading for over a year
caption:
🦠 Health Setback: US Reportedly Loses Measles-Free Status After 26 Years

The United States has lost its "measles eliminated" status, which it held since 2000, according to reports by Reuters and CNN on Friday. Reuters, citing the Wall Street Journal, said the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) took the step because measles kept spreading in the US for more than a year.

🔹 The CDC had counted 5,182 confirmed measles cases in 2026 as of Thursday, from 45 states, New York City and Washington, D.C. That is more than double the 2,289 cases in all of 2025.
🔹 State health officials have reported at least 10 measles-related deaths in the US this year, after two more were reported in Pennsylvania and Wisconsin.
🔹 PAHO and the US health department had not commented publicly when the reports came out. Experts say two doses of the measles vaccine give about 97% protection.

💬 Do you think more people should get vaccinated against measles? 👇

Sources: Reuters, CNN, Al Jazeera

#GlobalEye #Measles #PublicHealth #USA #Vaccines #WorldNews
photo_needed: A measles vaccine vial and syringe (MMR vaccine), or a doctor/nurse giving a vaccine shot to a child's arm (face not needed). A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Post-Messi Era Begins!] Uruguay Beat Argentina [2-1] at La Bombonera
sub: First Argentina match since Messi retired
caption:
⚽ Post-Messi Era Begins: Uruguay Beat Argentina 2-1 at La Bombonera

Uruguay beat Argentina 2-1 in a friendly at La Bombonera in Buenos Aires on Friday night. It was Argentina's first match since Lionel Messi retired from international football in early October.

🔹 Uruguay scored twice early in the second half: a Leonardo Balerdi own goal (48') and a goal by Maxi Araújo (53'). Julián Álvarez pulled one back for Argentina in the 73rd minute.
🔹 Argentina left the No. 10 shirt unassigned. Coach Lionel Scaloni said: "We have to rebuild without Leo Messi, and we have the talent to bounce back from this loss."
🔹 Messi ended his Argentina career with 125 goals in 207 games. Argentina play Costa Rica in Córdoba on Tuesday.

💬 Who should wear Argentina's No. 10 shirt next? 👇

Sources: ESPN, AP

#GlobalEye #Argentina #Uruguay #Messi #Football #Scaloni
photo_needed: Argentina vs Uruguay match at La Bombonera (players in action, landscape), or Uruguay players celebrating. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Hormuz Blasts!] Iran Says [3 Oil Tankers] Hit Mines and Caught Fire
sub: Iran says ships used banned routes
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Iran Says 3 Oil Tankers Hit Mines and Caught Fire in Hormuz

Iran's navy and Revolutionary Guards said on Saturday that three oil tankers hit naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire. Iran says the ships had switched off their tracking systems and were using routes it does not allow.

🔹 Iran said two of the tankers were hit in the south of the strait, one of them a supertanker. A third was hit east of the strait. The ships' names and any casualties were not given, and there is no independent confirmation yet.
🔹 The UN told the Security Council on Friday that at least 25 seafarers have been killed in and around Hormuz since the war began in February.
🔹 Shipping through Hormuz is about 65% below pre-war levels, the UK's maritime agency (UKMTO) says. The US military says it has cleared the main routes of mines.

💬 How do you think this will affect oil prices? 👇

Sources: AFP, Al Jazeera, Middle East Eye

#GlobalEye #Hormuz #Iran #OilTankers #Shipping #WorldNews
photo_needed: Oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz (ideally a tanker on fire or with smoke), or a wide shot of tankers in the strait. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Historic First!] Trump, Xi and Putin to Hold [Three-Way Summit] in China
sub: Nuclear arms and Iran war on the agenda
caption:
🌍 Historic First: Trump, Xi and Putin to Hold Three-Way Summit in China

The White House said on Friday that US President Donald Trump will meet Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen, China, next week. It will be the first three-way meeting of the three leaders, held on the sidelines of the APEC summit.

🔹 White House spokesperson Olivia Wales said Trump will discuss "the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world". The New START nuclear treaty between the US and Russia expired in February.
🔹 US officials said the Iran war will also be discussed, but Ukraine will not. A senior US official told Reuters: "We do not expect to get to any kind of agreement."
🔹 The APEC leaders' meeting runs on 18-19 November. Moscow and Beijing had not commented when the plan was announced.

💬 Do you think this meeting can lead to a nuclear deal? 👇

Sources: Al Jazeera, Euronews, AFP

#GlobalEye #Trump #XiJinping #Putin #APEC #NuclearWeapons #WorldNews
photo_needed: Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin - a side-by-side photo or collage of the three leaders, faces clearly visible. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Big Ruling!] ICC Stops Probe Into Alleged Crimes by [US Troops] in Afghanistan
sub: Court will now focus on the Taliban
caption:
⚖️ Big Ruling: ICC Stops Probe Into Alleged Crimes by US Troops in Afghanistan

Judges at the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague have ordered the prosecutor to stop investigating alleged crimes by American troops in Afghanistan. The ruling was issued on Thursday and made public on Friday.

🔹 The court's Afghanistan inquiry will now focus only on alleged crimes by the Taliban since 2021. A separate probe into the ISIS group in Khorasan (ISKP) was also closed.
🔹 The judges cited "significant limitations to the Prosecution's ability to conduct its investigations and secure evidence." The US troops part of the probe had been inactive since 2021.
🔹 The prosecutor's office says it has already appealed. Arrest warrants for four Taliban leaders remain in force. The US is not an ICC member and has put sanctions on court staff.

💬 Should international courts be able to investigate any country's soldiers? 👇

Sources: Reuters, AP, Al Jazeera

#GlobalEye #ICC #Afghanistan #Taliban #USA #WorldNews
photo_needed: International Criminal Court (ICC) building in The Hague, with the ICC sign/logo clearly visible. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Last-Ball Thriller!] India Beat Pakistan to Win [U-19 Asia Cup] Final
sub: India chase 338 with one wicket left
caption:
🏏 Last-Ball Thriller: India Beat Pakistan to Win U-19 Asia Cup Final

India beat Pakistan by one wicket in the Under-19 Asia Cup final in Muscat, Oman, on Saturday. India needed three runs off the very last ball, and Mohit Ulva hit a four to win the match.

🔹 Pakistan won the toss and made 337 for 9. Usman Khan scored 107, Abdul Qadir 80 and captain Farhan Yousaf 63. India's Kavya Patel took 4 wickets for 68 runs.
🔹 India chased 338 and finished on 339 for 9 in 50 overs. Mohit Ulva was not out on 49 off just 26 balls.
🔹 It is India's ninth U-19 Asia Cup title. Pakistan were the defending champions.

💬 Who was your star of this final? 👇

Sources: ESPNcricinfo, The Week, Outlook India

#GlobalEye #U19AsiaCup #INDvPAK #Cricket #Pakistan #India
photo_needed: India Under-19 team celebrating with the U-19 Asia Cup trophy (or the India vs Pakistan U-19 final in Muscat), faces clearly visible. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [History Made!] SpaceX Catches Starship With Tower Arms After [14 Orbits]
sub: First catch of a Starship back from space
caption:
🚀 History Made: SpaceX Catches Starship With Tower Arms After 14 Orbits

SpaceX caught its Starship spacecraft with the giant arms of its launch tower at Starbase, Texas, on Saturday. It is the first time a Starship has been caught after returning from space. The ship landed about 22 hours after it took off on Friday.

🔹 On its 15th test flight, Starship circled Earth 14 times at about 265 km (165 miles) up and released 26 Starlink satellites.
🔹 The Super Heavy booster did not come back as planned. Its engines stopped too early and it was destroyed over the Gulf of Mexico. SpaceX is investigating.
🔹 Catching rockets is key to reusing them. NASA plans to use Starship as a Moon lander. NASA chief Jared Isaacman said: "It was almost magic."

💬 Would you like to travel to space one day? 👇

Sources: AP, CNN, CNBC

#GlobalEye #SpaceX #Starship #ElonMusk #Space #NASA
photo_needed: SpaceX Starship spacecraft held by the launch tower arms ("Mechazilla") at Starbase, Texas - or a Starship launch photo. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Heaviest Home Loss!] Portugal Crushed [4-1] by Denmark in First Game Without Ronaldo
sub: Hojlund scores twice in Nations League rout
caption:
⚽ Heaviest Home Loss! Portugal Crushed 4-1 by Denmark in First Game Without Ronaldo

Denmark beat Portugal 4-1 in Braga on Saturday in the UEFA Nations League. It was Portugal's first match since Cristiano Ronaldo announced his international retirement last week.

🔹 Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg scored a penalty before half-time, Rasmus Hojlund scored twice early in the second half, and Joachim Andersen added a header. Bernardo Silva scored late for Portugal.
🔹 ESPN says it is Portugal's heaviest home defeat in a competitive match.
🔹 Portugal are already in the quarter-finals but must avoid defeat against Wales on Tuesday to win the group.

💬 Can Portugal bounce back without Ronaldo? 👇

Sources: ESPN, BBC Sport

#GlobalEye #Football #NationsLeague #Portugal #Denmark #Ronaldo #Hojlund
photo_needed: Denmark players celebrating a goal against Portugal in Braga (Rasmus Hojlund if possible), or the match scene. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Gaza Strike] Israel Kills Hamas Rafah Brigade Chief [Samir Abu Younis]
sub: Hamas confirms death; strike hit Khan Younis
caption:
📍 Gaza Strike Israel Kills Hamas Rafah Brigade Chief Samir Abu Younis

Israel's military says it carried out a strike on Saturday that targeted a senior commander of Hamas's armed wing in Khan Younis, southern Gaza. Hamas confirmed that Samir Abu Younis, the commander of its Rafah brigade, was killed. Medics said the strike hit the Mawasi area and wounded others.

🔹 Abu Younis, 53, had been a member of Hamas's armed wing, the Al-Qassam Brigades, since 1991, Reuters reported.
🔹 Gaza health authorities say at least 1,600 Palestinians have been killed since the October 2025 ceasefire began. Five Israeli soldiers have died in the same period.
🔹 The ceasefire stopped major fighting, but strikes have continued and Hamas has not disarmed.

💬 What do you think is next for the Gaza ceasefire? 👇

Sources: Reuters, Al Jazeera

#GlobalEye #Gaza #Hamas #Israel #KhanYounis #MiddleEast
photo_needed: Khan Younis / al-Mawasi area of southern Gaza (tents, street or smoke after the strike - no graphic images), or an official photo of Samir Abu Younis if one exists. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Border Shutdown!] Estonia to Close All Crossings With Russia From [December 1]
sub: Tallinn blames Russian spy agency for arson plot
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Border Shutdown! Estonia to Close All Crossings With Russia From December 1

Estonia will close all of its border crossings with Russia from December 1, Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna announced on Sunday. The decision comes after an attempted arson attack on Estonian drone maker Threod Systems early on Saturday, which Estonian authorities say was ordered by Russia's GRU military intelligence service.

🔹 Three crossings are open now, at Narva, Koidula and Luhamaa. The minister did not say how long the closure will last.
🔹 Eight people were detained over the attack, which caused only minor damage. Russia had not commented, and it has denied similar accusations in the past.
🔹 Tsahkna said: "Russia must understand that hostile actions against Estonia come with consequences." Finland, Latvia and Lithuania have been informed.

💬 Do you think closing the border will make Estonia safer? 👇

Sources: Reuters, dpa

#GlobalEye #Estonia #Russia #Europe #Narva #BorderClosure
photo_needed: Estonia-Russia border crossing at Narva (the bridge / checkpoint, or Narva castle by the border river), or Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna with face clearly visible.

headline: [Yemen War Shift!] Houthis Advance to [60 km] From Aden as Government Retreats
sub: Forces pull back from Bab el-Mandeb Strait
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Yemen War Shift! Houthis Advance to 60 km From Aden as Government Retreats

Yemen's Houthis have advanced to about 60 km (37 miles) from Aden, the temporary seat of Yemen's internationally recognised government, military and government sources told AFP on Sunday. Earlier the same day, Saudi-backed government forces said they were pulling out of areas near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait to focus on defending Aden.

🔹 Sources say the Houthis seized two districts in Lahj province and reached the Al-Kharaz camp, where the UN refugee agency says 9,600 refugees are at risk.
🔹 The Houthis now say they hold more than 150 km of the Red Sea coast that government forces left. Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world's most important shipping routes.
🔹 Government forces have been building sandbag defences and digging tunnels around Aden. The UN says more than 1,600 people have been killed since fighting restarted in July.

💬 What do you think will happen next in Yemen? 👇

Sources: AFP, Reuters, Al Jazeera

#GlobalEye #Yemen #Houthis #Aden #RedSea #BabElMandeb
photo_needed: Houthi fighters or Yemeni government soldiers on the front line near Aden, or the city of Aden / Aden port (wide view). Avoid graphic images.

headline: [Big Build-Up!] [Third US Aircraft Carrier] Reaches Middle East Amid Iran Tensions
sub: Iran says it will not wait to be attacked
caption:
⚓ Big Build-Up! Third US Aircraft Carrier Reaches Middle East Amid Iran Tensions

The US aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt and its strike group have arrived in the Middle East, a US official told ABC News and Al Jazeera. It entered the area of US Central Command on Sunday, November 15.

🔹 The US now has three aircraft carriers in the region: the Roosevelt, the USS George H.W. Bush and the USS George Washington.
🔹 Late on Sunday, Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi said Tehran "will not wait for the US to attack first."
🔹 The move comes as tensions with Iran stay high and Donald Trump begins a trip to Asia this week, with Iran expected to be discussed at talks with China's Xi Jinping.

💬 What do you think this means for the region? 👇

Sources: ABC News, Al Jazeera, Axios

#GlobalEye #USNavy #Iran #MiddleEast #TheodoreRoosevelt #WorldNews
photo_needed: USS Theodore Roosevelt aircraft carrier at sea (wide landscape photo, e.g. from the US Navy website).

headline: [Perfect Debut!] Mirra Andreeva, 19, Wins [WTA Finals] Without Losing a Set
sub: Beats Elina Svitolina 7-5, 6-3
caption:
🏆 Perfect Debut! Mirra Andreeva, 19, Wins WTA Finals Without Losing a Set

Russia's Mirra Andreeva won the WTA Finals on Sunday, beating Ukraine's Elina Svitolina 7-5, 6-3 in the final at Indian Wells, California. It was her first time playing at the season-ending event.

🔹 Andreeva, 19, won all five of her matches without dropping a set.
🔹 She takes home $3.37 million, the biggest possible prize at the event.
🔹 The win lifts her to a career-high world No. 2 in the rankings.

💬 Can Andreeva become world No. 1 next year? 👇

Sources: Reuters, AFP

headline: [43-Game Run Over!] 10-Man England Stun Spain [3-2] in Madrid
sub: England top Nations League group
caption:
⚽ 43-Game Run Over! 10-Man England Stun Spain 3-2 in Madrid

England beat world champions Spain 3-2 in the UEFA Nations League on Sunday night at the Metropolitano stadium in Madrid. The result ended Spain's 43-match unbeaten run.

🔹 Harry Kane scored a penalty just before half-time, then Ezri Konsa (53rd minute) and Ben White added goals to make it 3-0.
🔹 England's Elliot Anderson was sent off for a foul on Lamine Yamal. Mikel Oyarzabal scored the penalty, and substitute Nico Williams made it 3-2.
🔹 England finish top of Group A3 on goal difference. Both teams go through to the Nations League quarter-finals in March.

💬 Was this England's best win in years? 👇

Sources: AFP, ESPN, The National

#GlobalEye #England #Spain #NationsLeague #HarryKane #Football
photo_needed: England players celebrating a goal against Spain in Madrid (e.g. Harry Kane, Ezri Konsa or Ben White), faces clearly visible.

headline: [First-Ever Failure!] ULA Rocket Loses [40 Amazon Satellites] After Launch
sub: Vulcan fails 10 minutes into flight
caption:
🚀 First-Ever Failure! ULA Rocket Loses 40 Amazon Satellites After Launch

A Vulcan rocket from United Launch Alliance (ULA), a joint company of Boeing and Lockheed Martin, failed after lifting off from Cape Canaveral, Florida, on Sunday, November 15. All 40 satellites it carried for Amazon's Leo internet network were lost.

🔹 ULA said the rocket "suffered an anomaly 10 minutes into the flight and failed to deliver the Amazon mission to orbit." The cause is not yet known.
🔹 It is ULA's first full mission failure since the company was formed in 2006. It was the fifth Vulcan flight and its first in nine months.
🔹 ULA says it will investigate with its customer and return to flight as quickly as possible. NASA has offered to help. Amazon Leo is building a satellite internet network to compete with SpaceX's Starlink.

💬 Can Amazon still catch up with Starlink? 👇

Sources: Reuters, Anadolu Agency, Spaceflight Now

#GlobalEye #ULA #Vulcan #Amazon #AmazonLeo #Space
photo_needed: ULA Vulcan rocket on the launch pad or lifting off at Cape Canaveral (wide landscape photo, e.g. from ULA's website or press kit).

headline: [Legend Returns!] Ronaldinho, 46, Plays First Match in [11 Years]
sub: Ravenna beat Forli 2-0 in Italy
caption:
⚽ Legend Returns! Ronaldinho, 46, Plays First Match in 11 Years

Brazil legend Ronaldinho played his first official match in more than 11 years on Sunday, November 15, for Italian third-tier club Ravenna. Ravenna beat local rivals Forlì 2-0 at the sold-out Stadio Bruno Benelli.

🔹 Ronaldinho, 46, played the whole first half and helped build the move for Giulio Donati's opening goal. He had been expected to play only about 30 minutes.
🔹 His last official match was for Fluminense in Brazil on September 26, 2015. He joined Ravenna as an investor in August.

headline: [Deadly Blaze!] Fire Kills [11 People] on Thailand's Phuket Island
sub: Transformer blast reported before fire
caption:
🔥 Deadly Blaze! Fire Kills 11 People on Thailand's Phuket Island

A fire killed at least 11 people early on Monday, November 16, in Patong, the main tourist area of Phuket island in southern Thailand, police said. It started in a building with a motorcycle rental shop on the ground floor and homes on the upper floors, and spread to nearby buildings.

🔹 At least 16 people were injured, treated for smoke and broken glass injuries. Authorities said no tourists were among the dead or injured.
🔹 Police said early checks show an electrical transformer near the building exploded shortly before the fire began. They ruled out arson, and the cause is still being investigated.
🔹 Phuket's governor said about 100 motorcycles, plus gas, engine oil, plastic and tyres stored in the shop, may have helped the fire spread fast and create thick, toxic smoke.

💬 Should fire safety checks be stricter in busy tourist areas? 👇

headline: [Chip Crackdown!] US Moves to Block China's [Remote Access] to AI Chips
sub: Licences now needed for overseas data centers
caption:
💻 Chip Crackdown! US Moves to Block China's Remote Access to AI Chips

The US Commerce Department announced a new rule on Monday, November 16, to stop Chinese companies from using advanced American AI chips remotely through data centers in other countries. Selling these chips directly to China already needs a US licence.

🔹 Data centers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil will now need a US licence to receive advanced AI chips from Nvidia and other US makers. US-based companies operating there are exempt.
🔹 Exporters and data center operators must check that no company from China or other restricted countries is controlling or using the computing power, including through middlemen.
🔹 The move comes days after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepped down over reports linking him to a woman US officials reportedly suspected of being a Chinese operative. Nvidia reports its earnings on Tuesday.

💬 Will this rule really stop AI chips from reaching China? 👇

Sources: NPR, Bloomberg

sub: Says it is up to China's Xi
caption:
🇺🇸🇰🇵 Surprise Hint! Trump Says He May Meet Kim Jong Un in China

US President Donald Trump said on Monday, November 16, that he may meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un during his trip to China. Speaking to reporters at the White House before leaving for Asia, he said: "He may come. I don't know. That's up to President Xi."

🔹 Trump is due to meet China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China.
🔹 There are no known plans for a meeting yet. North Korea is not an APEC member, and South Korea's foreign minister said Kim was unlikely to attend.

sub: Nvidia board not considering it, AP reports
caption:
💻 Comeback Call? Trump Says He Would Not Mind Jensen Huang Returning to Nvidia

US President Donald Trump said on Monday, November 16, that he "would certainly not mind" if Jensen Huang returned as CEO of Nvidia. Huang resigned last week after reports of extramarital affairs. Trump said Huang had "learned a big lesson" and that he sees no national security risk.

🔹 Nvidia's chief financial officer, Colette Kress, is serving as interim CEO while the board looks for a replacement.
🔹 Some supporters are pushing for Huang's return, but a person familiar with the board's thinking told AP the board is not currently considering it.
🔹 Nvidia, the world's most valuable chipmaker, is due to report its quarterly earnings on Tuesday.

sub: FIFA vote in Morocco, March 2027
caption:
⚽ FIFA Battle! UEFA Backs France's Philippe Diallo to Challenge Infantino

UEFA, European football's governing body, has given its unanimous backing to French Football Federation president Philippe Diallo, 63, to run against Gianni Infantino for the FIFA presidency. Diallo has accepted, and his candidacy is due to be confirmed by the French federation on Tuesday.

🔹 The FIFA presidential election will take place at the FIFA Congress in Rabat, Morocco, on March 18, 2027.
🔹 Infantino, FIFA president since 2016, is seeking re-election and is backed by the Asian Football Confederation.

headline: [Airspace Alert!] Japan Scrambles Fighters as Suspected [Russian Planes] Enter
sub: Tokyo protests, first breach since 2024
caption:
✈️ Airspace Alert! Japan Scrambles Fighters as Suspected Russian Planes Enter

Two suspected Russian military aircraft entered Japanese airspace near Okinoshima, an island off Fukuoka in southwestern Japan, at about 4 a.m. local time on Tuesday, November 17. Japan sent fighter jets, which warned the planes by radio. Each plane stayed in Japanese airspace for about three minutes.

🔹 Japan said it is the first violation of its airspace by Russian aircraft since September 2024. Tokyo lodged a "very stern protest" with Russia.
🔹 Defence Minister Shinjiro Koizumi called it "a serious violation of our sovereignty" and "utterly unacceptable".
🔹 South Korea also sent fighter jets after Russian aircraft entered its air defence zone, but said its airspace was not violated. Leaders of Japan and Russia are both expected at the APEC summit in China this week.

headline: [Major Strike!] Ukraine Hits Crimea Bridge Again, Zelensky Says Section [Collapsed]
sub: Two killed, bridge traffic suspended
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Ukraine Hits Crimea Bridge Again, Zelensky Says Section Collapsed

Ukraine attacked the Crimean Bridge (Kerch Bridge), the only road link between southern Russia and occupied Crimea, for the second day in a row on Tuesday, November 17. President Volodymyr Zelensky called the attack "unprecedented" and shared video he said shows the bridge's main road arch and part of the roadway collapsed. Reuters said it could not verify the footage.

🔹 Crimea's Russian-installed governor, Sergei Aksyonov, said two people were killed and traffic on the bridge was suspended.
🔹 Russia said it shot down 1,441 Ukrainian drones over 22 regions overnight, a new record. Russia also struck two bridges in Kyiv, causing some power and water cuts.
🔹 Zelensky said the attack was a response to Russian strikes on Ukraine's infrastructure. It comes days before Putin, Xi Jinping and Donald Trump are due to meet in China.

💬 What will this mean for the talks in China this week? 👇

headline: [Shock Exit!] Mongolia's President [Khurelsukh] Resigns Over Corruption Claims
sub: He denies $25M bribe claim; parliament to vote
caption:
🏛️ Shock Exit! Mongolia's President Khurelsukh Resigns Over Corruption Claims

Mongolia's President Ukhnaa Khurelsukh, 58, announced his resignation on Tuesday, November 17, in an address to the nation. He faces corruption allegations, which he denies. "I have never stolen from my people or my state," he said, adding that he will cooperate with investigators.

🔹 Former Ulaanbaatar mayor Nyambaatar Khishgee, from a rival faction of the ruling Mongolian People's Party, accused him of receiving $25 million linked to a 2019 railway contract given without a competitive tender while he was prime minister. The company named, Bodi International, denies paying bribes.
🔹 The opposition Democratic Party had called for him to resign and wants an inquiry into money flows from the mining sector.
🔹 The resignation takes effect only if parliament accepts it, with a vote expected this week. If accepted, the speaker of parliament becomes interim president.

💬 Was resigning the right move while the claims are investigated? 👇

Sources: AP, Bloomberg, DPA

headline: [Sanctions Hit!] UK Freezes Assets of [8 Israeli Firms] Building West Bank Settlements
sub: Group accused of blocking Gaza aid also hit
caption:
⚖️ Sanctions Hit! UK Freezes Assets of 8 Israeli Firms Building West Bank Settlements

The UK government on Tuesday, November 17, announced sanctions on eight Israeli property and construction companies that build homes in West Bank settlements. It also sanctioned Tzav 9, an Israeli activist group the UK says has repeatedly blocked aid trucks heading into Gaza. All nine face asset freezes in the UK, and people linked to them are barred from serving as directors of UK companies.

🔹 Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said "illegal settlement expansion in the West Bank is destroying the prospects of a two-state solution." His message to firms about the E1 settlement project east of Jerusalem: "do not bid, do not build, and do not profit from the destruction of the two-state solution."
🔹 The sanctions came shortly before the deadline for bids to build homes in E1. Britain says the project would cut East Jerusalem off from Palestinian areas of the West Bank.
🔹 Israel's government had no immediate comment. Israel Ganz, head of the Yesha settlers' council, said the UK had "declared economic war against Israel." These are the first concrete steps of wider UK measures announced in September.

💬 Will sanctions like these change anything on the ground? 👇

Sources: AP, Al Jazeera, Times of Israel

headline: [Record Quarter!] Nvidia Makes [$115.8 Billion] in First Results Without Huang
sub: Revenue up 103% with Colette Kress in charge
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Record Quarter! Nvidia Makes $115.8 Billion in First Results Without Huang

Nvidia on Tuesday, November 17, reported revenue of $115.8 billion for the three months to October 25, up 103% from a year ago. It is the chip giant's first earnings report since founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO last week. Interim CEO Colette Kress, the company's long-time finance chief, led the results call.

🔹 Profit rose 105% to $65.3 billion. Analysts had expected revenue of about $109 billion, according to FactSet (via CBS News).
🔹 Data center sales, mostly AI chips, reached $107.6 billion. Nvidia expects about $130 billion next quarter and is not counting on any data center chip sales to China.
🔹 Shares rose in after-hours trading. A source told CBS News the board is against bringing Huang back as CEO. Kress said: "Our momentum is real."

💬 Can Nvidia keep growing like this without Jensen Huang? 👇

Sources: Nvidia (official statement), CBS News

sub: After Iranian drones targeted Bahrain base
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Strike Back! US Jets Hit Iranian Missile Site on Qeshm Island

US fighter jets struck a missile launch site run by Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) on Qeshm Island, near the Strait of Hormuz, on Tuesday, November 17. A US military official called it a strike "in self-defense" after Iranian drones were launched toward Bahrain.

🔹 US Central Command said the Iranian drones aimed at Bahrain were shot down, with no damage to US equipment and no injuries to Americans. The IRGC said it targeted a US radar at Bahrain's Isa Air Base.
🔹 Iranian state media called the strike an "enemy attack". A local official said it did not damage vital, commercial or residential areas.
🔹 Qatar said it is still mediating between the US and Iran. Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi visited Oman on the same day.

sub: An-12 cargo plane crashed near Kemerovo
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Deadly Crash! Russian Military Plane Goes Down in Siberia, 19 Killed

A Russian military An-12 transport plane crashed on Tuesday, November 17, near the village of Yagunovo in the Kemerovo region of Siberia. Russia's Defence Ministry said all 19 people on board were killed.

🔹 Witnesses said the plane caught fire in the air, dropped quickly and exploded when it hit the ground.
🔹 The cause is not yet known. A Russian Aerospace Forces commission is at the site, and investigators have opened a case into possible flight safety violations.
🔹 The An-12 is a Soviet-era four-engine cargo plane first used in the late 1950s.

sub: Norway came back from 2-0 down
caption:
⚽ Late Drama! Haaland's 96th-Minute Penalty Sends Norway Past Denmark 3-2

Norway came from 2-0 down to beat Denmark 3-2 in Copenhagen on Tuesday, November 17, in the UEFA Nations League. Erling Haaland scored twice, including a penalty in the 96th minute that won the match.

🔹 Rasmus Højlund and Pierre-Emile Højbjerg put Denmark 2-0 up within the first 14 minutes.
🔹 Haaland pulled one back before half-time, Martin Ødegaard equalised in the 83rd minute, and Haaland scored the winning penalty in added time after a Denmark handball.

caption:

Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin held talks in Shenzhen, China, on Wednesday, November 18, on the sidelines of the APEC summit. The talks lasted more than two hours, according to Russia's TASS news agency. It comes one day before a planned three-way meeting with US President Donald Trump.

🔹 Xi said China-Russia ties stand "as firm as a mountain". Putin said what the world needs is "unity rather than division" and "dialogue rather than ultimatums".
🔹 Xi called for more cooperation on AI and free trade and said China would lower tariffs. Putin said Western sanctions have failed to stop Russia's economy.

caption:

US President Donald Trump landed in Shenzhen, China, on Wednesday, November 18, for the APEC summit. Chinese President Xi Jinping met him on the tarmac as he stepped off Air Force One. The two leaders shook hands and hugged, then walked a red carpet to their cars.

🔹 Trump came from the Philippines, where he met President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. In September, Trump personally welcomed Xi at Joint Base Andrews near Washington.

caption:

Iran launched drone and air attacks on Kuwait and Bahrain early on Wednesday, November 18. Both countries said their air defences intercepted the attacks. Iran said it was responding to a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island on Tuesday.

🔹 Iran's military said it targeted US Patriot air defence systems and drone and missile launchers at Kuwait's Ali Al Salem Air Base, which hosts US forces. No casualties or damage were reported.

US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin shook hands and exchanged greetings in Shenzhen, China, on Wednesday, November 18, at the APEC summit. It was their first in-person meeting since their Alaska summit in August 2025.

caption:

Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto VI launches today, Thursday, November 19. Rockstar says it unlocks at midnight local time in each region, so some countries get it hours before others. It is the first new main GTA game since GTA V came out in 2013.
